card: Prevents output groups failing eligibility filters from being recorded twice when -avoidpartialspends or avoid_reuse is active. In those modes, output groups were pushed to discarded_groups in both the mixed and positive-only passes, causing AutomaticCoinSelection to double-subtract their value from available funds and spuriously fail with an insufficient funds error. The fix records discards only on the mixed pass, and adds both a C++ unit test and a functional regression test reproducing the failure with an unconfirmed ancestor chain.
changed_since_previous: Added a C++ unit test in group_outputs_tests.cpp verifying that ineligible output groups are discarded only once, and exported the corresponding GroupOutputs overload taking ret_discarded_groups in spend.h.
evidence: Author description: 'AutomaticCoinSelection then subtracts it twice and could fail with an insufficient funds error even when there would be enough confirmed coins to cover the payment.'

Functional test test_too_long_mempool_chain_avoid_partial_spends in test/functional/wallet_create_tx.py directly reproduces the spurious insufficient funds failure caused by a 25-ancestor mempool chain alongside confirmed funds.
problem: When `-avoidpartialspends` or `avoid_reuse` is used, `GroupOutputs` evaluates positive-value output groups in both mixed and positive-only maps. Groups failing eligibility filters (such as coins hitting mempool ancestor limits) were inserted into `discarded_groups` twice, leading `AutomaticCoinSelection` to double-subtract their value from available funds and spuriously fail with an insufficient funds error despite having enough confirmed coins.

risk.why: A mistake in output grouping could cause coin selection to miscalculate available balances or select invalid coin combinations when creating transactions.

summary: Prevents output groups from being added to the discarded list twice when `-avoidpartialspends` or `avoid_reuse` is enabled. Discards are now recorded only during the mixed group evaluation pass instead of both the mixed and positive-only passes. It also exposes the `GroupOutputs` discard-tracking overload in the wallet header and adds both unit and functional regression tests.
